mapper.sql: select t.*, c.name city_name, p.name province_name, co.name country_name, (select group_concat(tg.name order by tg.sort desc, tg.id separator ', ') from voya_ai_guide_tag gt join voya_ai_tag tg on tg.id = gt.tag_id where gt.guide_id = t.id and tg.del_flag = '0' and tg.status = '0') tag_names from voya_ai_guide t left join voya_ai_city c on c.id = t.city_id left join voya_ai_province p on p.id = c.province_id left join voya_ai_country co on co.id = p.country_id
mapper.select: where t.id = #{id} and t.del_flag = '0' and t.publish_status = '1' and c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '0' and p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0' and co.del_flag = '0' and co.status = '0'
select * from voya_ai_guide where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' for update
select count(*) from voya_ai_guide where city_id = #{cityId} and title = #{title} and del_flag = '0'and id != #{id}

(select count(*) from voya_ai_favorite where target_type = 'guide' and target_id = #{id}) + (select count(*) from voya_ai_like where target_type = 'guide' and target_id = #{id}) + (select count(*) from voya_ai_comment where target_type = 'guide' and target_id = #{id} and del_flag = '0')
select count(*) from voya_ai_tag where id in #{id} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
mapper.update: update voya_ai_guide set city_id=#{cityId},title=#{title},cover_image=#{coverImage},summary=#{summary},content=#{content},guide_type=#{guideType},days=#{days},budget_min=#{budgetMin},budget_max=#{budgetMax},publish_status=#{publishStatus},publish_time=#{publishTime},sort=#{sort},remark=#{remark},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=now() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
update voya_ai_guide set publish_status=#{publishStatus},publish_time=#{publishTime},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=now() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
update voya_ai_guide set del_flag='1',update_by=#{username},update_time=now() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select group_concat(t.name order by t.sort desc,t.id separator ', ') from voya_ai_guide_tag gt join voya_ai_tag t on t.id=gt.tag_id where gt.guide_id=#{guideId} and t.del_flag='0' and t.status='0'
select tag_id from voya_ai_guide_tag where guide_id=#{guideId} order by id
